method: Source inspection of every owner/incomeos module header, storage and network calls; full test run; this cycle's changes. Existence of a file or a passing synthetic test is not treated as operational readiness.

stateDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED: Implemented, and its logic verified by tests in this repository. Not a claim of live operation unless stated.
stateDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED: Implemented; verification depends on an external run not yet observed.
stateDefinitions.SIMULATED_OR_SYNTHETIC_ONLY: Logic exists and is tested only with synthetic data; no authenticated real source.
stateDefinitions.BLOCKED_BY_EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY: Requires a credential, authorization or external action.
